name: StereoSet
description: A large-scale benchmark to measure stereotypical bias in language models across four categories: race, profession, gender, and religion. Presents models with intrasentence and intersentence context-completion tasks to measure stereotype endorsement.
reputation: Widely-used stereotype measurement benchmark; jointly measures bias and language modeling ability via iCAT score
notes: iCAT score balances stereotype score (less stereotypical is better) and language modeling score (coherent text preferred). Tests both context-sentence and fill-in-the-blank stereotype completion.
